clusters.label: Self-healability

clusters.label: Thermal conductivity
clusters.definition: The material quantity describing heat conduction in response to a temperature gradient.
clusters.reason: These mentions identify thermal conductivity itself, rather than its change or a scattering mechanism. Different materials and effects remain attached to their claims. Lattice conductivity is explicitly distinguished in several contexts and is not substituted for the broader quantity.

clusters.label: Thermal conductivity (calculated)
clusters.definition: Thermal conductivity evaluated through theoretical or computational calculations.
clusters.reason: Each context explicitly identifies a calculated quantity or a DFT prediction. These are kept separate from experimental or generic mentions; no unstated electronic or lattice component is inferred.

clusters.label: Reduced graphene oxide
clusters.definition: The reduced graphene oxide material constituent identified as rGO.
clusters.reason: Both explicitly identify rGO as a constituent supporting electronic transport. The cement composite and ionogel are distinct hosts, not identities assigned to rGO.

clusters.label: Excellent mechanical flexibility
clusters.definition: A pronounced ability to accommodate mechanical bending or deformation.
clusters.reason: All denote the same qualitative mechanical capability; the 500-cycle condition applies only to the module claim and does not establish a shared quantitative performance.

clusters.label: Ultrasensitive thermal sensing
clusters.definition: An application involving highly sensitive detection of temperature changes or differences.
clusters.reason: Both name the same proposed application, without establishing identical devices or sensitivity thresholds.
